arms.name: koger
arms.title: koger
arms.reason: The image shows a palm-leaf blowgun dart quiver bound with fiber cord, with a small woven fiber pouch (for curare poison/kapok) attached, matching Fejos's documented Yagua quiver type from northeastern Peru. This is a weapon accessory made and used by the Yagua people.

arms.name: dart
arms.title: dart
arms.reason: The image shows a bundle of blowgun darts wrapped in a palm-leaf quiver/sheath with a fiber cord, a hunting weapon type characteristic of Yagua and other Amazonian peoples, consistent with the claimed ethnicity and category.

jewelry.title: Collar
